text:
Alex: heads up — p99 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west jumped from ~400ms to ~2.7s at 10:32 UTC. Customers are starting to escalate.
Priya: on it. is this for all models or specific ones?
Alex: mainly the recon-v2 family and the small quantized variants. p95 moved from 120ms->450ms. error rate still low (~0.3%), just tail.
SRE-bot: Deploy detected: runtime-release v2.14.3 rolled to eu-west at 10:28 UTC by deploy-bot.
Sam: that matches timing. can we force traffic to an older runtime or rollback canary?
Priya: quick checklist: 1) add stricter rate-limit for non-authed tokens 2) enable circuit-breaker at 2s 3) route low-priority customer tiers to fallback model.
Jordan: I can flip routing. listing fallback: recon-v2 -> recon-v1-int8, and recon-v2-small -> recon-v2-tiny.
Alex: please also enable prefix KV cache bypass? last change touched batching heuristics — might be causing larger batch sizes and long latency.
Priya: adding temporary batching cap to 8 tokens/req via runtime flag now: `SET BATCH_MAX=8`
Sam: doing a soft throttling for free-tier clients: `rate_limit: 10rps` on the route. pushing in 30s.
Support-bot: support ticket #4521 created from acme-corp complaining about timeouts. cc @Jordan.
Jordan: rerouting low-priority traffic to us-east as secondary region for affected models. will take ~90s to warm.
Alex: run a quick smoke repro: curl -s -X POST https://eu-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}' -v and capture x-req-duration and x-queue-time headers.
Priya: I ran the curl, seeing `x-req-duration: 2.6s`, `x-queue-time: 0.02s`. so not queuing, likely execution path.
Sam: rolling a constrained rollback on runtime to v2.14.2 for canary nodes in eu-west (command: `deploy rollback runtime v2.14.2 --region eu-west --canary 30%`).
SRE-bot: Rollback started. Estimated 4m to converge.
Alex: in parallel, enable circuit-breaker to return 429 for requests > 2s to avoid cascading downstream effects. Priya, can you add an override on the API gateway?
Priya: gateway override applied. cb threshold = 2000ms, cooldown 60s.
Jordan: eu-west fallback served ~22% of traffic to us-east variant, tail improved slightly. p99 dropped to ~1.1s.
Sam: after 6m, rollback finished. p99 now ~420ms for restored nodes, combined p99 ~700ms across region.
Alex: nice. next steps: 1) postmortem to identify which kernel/runtime change caused execution tail 2) add automated canary metric alert to stop rollout if p99 increases > 30% within 5m 3) add slower fallback model routing as an automated playbook.
Support-bot: notified customer #4521 with mitigation summary and ETA for root cause.
Priya: creating follow-up ticket: RTC-987 - investigate batching heuristics change in v2.14.3. Assigning to runtime team.
Jordan: note: temporary config we used: gateway circuit-breaker + per-key rate-limit + cross-region fallback + constrained rollback. saving as quick-playbook snippet in runbooks.
Alex: thanks everyone. will schedule 1hr post-incident review at 15:00 UTC. please add observations to the ticket. :thumbsup:
Sam: leaving the gateway CB and rate-limits for now. will monitor for 2 hours then gradually relax.
SRE-bot: Monitoring alert cleared for high p99.
Alex: closing thread here but keep updates in RTC-987.
